ezekiel.35.p1.b1.text: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,

ezekiel.35.p1.b2.text: These two nations and countries will be ours, and we will possess them

ezekiel.35.p1.b3.text: They are desolate; they are given to us to devour!

ezekiel.35.p1.b4.text: Behold, I am against you, O Mount Seir. I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolate waste.

ezekiel.35.p1.b5.text: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

ezekiel.35.p1.b6.text: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, so will I do to you.
